properties.name: Cú Chulainn's Defense of Ulster
properties.summary: When Queen Medb of Connacht invaded Ulster to steal the Brown Bull, the teenage hero Cú Chulainn single-handedly defended the province at a ford, fighting champions in single combat for months due to a curse on the Ulster warriors. His battle frenzy (ríastrad) transformed him into a terrifying creature.

properties.name: The Quest for the Holy Grail
properties.summary: King Arthur's knights of the Round Table embarked on the quest for the Holy Grail, the cup used by Christ at the Last Supper. Only the pure-hearted Galahad succeeded, while Lancelot was denied for his adultery with Guinevere. The quest reveals each knight's spiritual worth and the limits of martial valor.

properties.name: Oisín in Tír na nÓg
properties.summary: The warrior Oisín fell in love with Niamh of the Golden Hair, who brought him to Tír na nÓg (Land of the Young). He lived there for what seemed three years but was actually 300. Returning to Ireland, he was forbidden to touch the ground. When he fell from his horse, he aged instantly into an old man.

properties.name: The Morrígan — Phantom Queen of Battle
properties.summary: The Morrígan is a triple goddess of war, fate, and death. She appears as a crow over battlefields, selecting who will die. She offered Cú Chulainn her love, and when refused, became his enemy — yet also his protector. Before battles, she washed the armor of those fated to die at the ford.

properties.name: Fionn and the Salmon of Knowledge
properties.summary: The druid Finnegas spent seven years fishing for the Salmon of Knowledge in the River Boyne. Young Fionn was tasked with cooking it but burned his thumb on the fish and instinctively sucked it. That taste gave him all the salmon's wisdom. Whenever he needed answers, he sucked his thumb to access infinite knowledge.
